title: WooCommerce Optimization
description: Performance and checkout optimization for established WooCommerce stores.

steps.title: Configure Product Permalinks
steps.instructions: Set product permalink base (e.g. /shop/ or /product/) and ensure category URLs are clean and consistent.

steps.title: Optimize Cart Fragments
steps.instructions: Disable or defer cart fragment AJAX on non-shop pages. Use a mini-cart that updates only on cart/checkout templates.

steps.title: Regenerate Product Images
steps.instructions: Regenerate WooCommerce thumbnail sizes after a theme switch. Confirm retina and gallery zoom images load correctly.

steps.title: Streamline Checkout
steps.instructions: Remove unnecessary checkout fields, enable guest checkout if appropriate, and test express payment buttons.

steps.title: Configure Cache Exclusions
steps.instructions: Exclude cart, checkout, my-account, and add-to-cart AJAX endpoints from full-page cache and CDN cache.

steps.title: Clear Action Scheduler Backlog
steps.instructions: Review WooCommerce → Status → Scheduled Actions. Clear failed or stuck batches that slow admin and cron.

steps.title: Verify HPOS / Order Storage
steps.instructions: If using High-Performance Order Storage, confirm sync is complete and legacy post-based orders are migrated.
